article_title: Cave art discovery suggests first humans in Ireland came from Wales

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Researchers finding ancient cave art that may push back the earliest known human presence in Ireland and support a Wales-to-Ireland land-bridge route
Archaeologists proving that farming began in Ireland 40,000 years ago
A plan to open all Irish cave sites to tourists
Scientists discovering that Ireland remained completely covered by sea during the Ice Age
tasks.correct_answer: Researchers finding ancient cave art that may push back the earliest known human presence in Ireland and support a Wales-to-Ireland land-bridge route
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת באמנות מערות עתיקה שעשויה להקדים בכ־5,000 שנה את העדות הידועה לנוכחות אדם באירלנד ולתמוך במסלול יבשתי מוויילס.

tasks.prompt: What created the possible route between Pembrokeshire and south-east Ireland during the Ice Age?
options: A chain of artificial wooden bridges
Lower sea levels exposed a land bridge
A frozen river crossed the Atlantic
A volcanic eruption joined the coasts
tasks.correct_answer: Lower sea levels exposed a land bridge
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ירידת פני הים בתקופת הקרח חשפה גשר יבשתי בין פמברוקשייר לבין אזור רוסלר באירלנד.

tasks.prompt: How did the research team narrow its search for Irish caves?
options: It searched only beside modern roads
It copied locations from medieval maps
It used an AI-assisted algorithm trained on characteristics of cave dwellings in south Wales
It followed herds of wild horses across the sea
tasks.correct_answer: It used an AI-assisted algorithm trained on characteristics of cave dwellings in south Wales
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החוקרים הזינו לאלגוריתם מאפיינים של מערות מגורים בדרום וויילס, והוא הציע אתרים דומים באירלנד.

tasks.prompt: Why are the exact cave locations being kept secret?
options: The team has forgotten how to reach them
The caves are outside Ireland
The researchers want to reduce the risk of vandalism or looting
The artwork is visible only in winter
tasks.correct_answer: The researchers want to reduce the risk of vandalism or looting
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החוקרים אינם מפרסמים מיקום מדויק כדי להגן על האתרים מפני השחתה או ביזה.

tasks.prompt: What does “absence of proof isn't proof of absence” mean in this investigation?
options: Old discoveries should always be rejected
Not finding evidence yet does not prove that early humans were not there
Every cave must contain human art
Computer models are more reliable than fieldwork
tasks.correct_answer: Not finding evidence yet does not prove that early humans were not there
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המשפט אומר שהיעדר ממצא עד כה אינו מוכיח שבני אדם קדומים לא היו במקום; ייתכן שפשוט לא חיפשו נכון.

tasks.prompt: What does “game-changer” mean when Nash describes advances in AI?
options: A tool used to entertain the researchers
A development that significantly changed what the team could achieve
A rule preventing cave exploration
A discovery that proved every earlier theory wrong
tasks.correct_answer: A development that significantly changed what the team could achieve
tasks.explanation_hebrew: game-changer הוא שינוי משמעותי שמאפשר דרך פעולה חדשה; כאן הבינה המלאכותית מיקדה את החיפוש במערות מבטיחות.

tasks.prompt: Explain how the team moved from a theory about migration to the discovery of eight cave-art sites.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר את ההשערה, כלי החיפוש, מספר האתרים שנבדקו והתוצאה.
expected_points: Nash believed hunter-gatherers would have used the exposed land bridge
The route linked modern Pembrokeshire with south-east Ireland
He assembled a multidisciplinary international team
They trained a computer algorithm using characteristics of south-Wales cave dwellings
The model identified 28 potential caves in south-west Ireland
The team investigated those candidates in the field
Eight caves contained art believed to be at least 15,000 years old

tasks.prompt: What environmental and social conditions could have encouraged people to move from Wales towards Ireland?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר לפחות שני גורמי משיכה סביבתיים ושני גורמי לחץ חברתיים או הישרדותיים.
expected_points: Lower sea levels created a walkable plateau about 46 miles or 76 km across
The plateau supported large animals such as horses, mammoths, bison and reindeer
Hunter-gatherers could follow animal migration routes
Caves offered temperatures of about 10°C to 15°C even when outside temperatures were far colder
Growing family networks increased population pressure
Competition for the many inhabited caves in the Gower Peninsula was intense
Improved survival knowledge may have made groups bolder about moving west and north

tasks.prompt: Summarise the evidence, method and significance of the Lost Land Bridge Project's discovery.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את גשר היבשה, השימוש ב־AI, ממצאי האמנות, התיארוך והמשמעות להיסטוריה האנושית באירלנד.
expected_points: An Ice Age land bridge may have linked Wales and Ireland
An AI-assisted model identified 28 promising caves
Researchers found art in eight south-west Irish caves
The art includes engravings, ochre and charcoal paintings, and finger-made lines
The sites date to at least 15,000 years ago and may be older
This is about 5,000 years earlier than the previous oldest evidence in Ireland
The findings support the idea that people crossed from Wales
Researchers expect further discoveries in areas such as Wexford, Waterford and Cork

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced science-news paragraph explaining what the discovery suggests and what remains uncertain.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית ולהבחין בין ראיות, פרשנות ואי־ודאות; אין להציג את ההשערה כהוכחה מוחלטת.
expected_points: State that eight caves contain art believed to be at least 15,000 years old
Compare the date with the earlier 10,500-year evidence
Explain the proposed Wales-Ireland land bridge

Describe at least one type of artwork found
